newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's inflation rose by 1.53 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's inflation rose by 1.53 pct in May.

text.p: Ecuador's consumer price index rose by 1.53 percent in May, up from 0.27 percent registered in the same month last year, the National Statistics and Census Institute said Friday.
Annual inflation in May was 31.18 percent and cumulative inflation for the first five months of 1997 was 15.8 percent.
In the first five months of 1996, cumulative inflation was 10.8 percent.
Inflation for 1996 was 25.5 percent, up from 22.8 percent in 1995.
In April, consumer prices rose 2.04 percent.
The government expects to close 1997 with an inflation rate of around 30 percent.
